source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of critical thinking (PDF 186).

blocks.text: Critical thinking skills (soch samajh kar parakhne ki salahiyat) maloomat ka tajziya (analysis) aur parakh ke liye zaroori hain. Is ka matlab hai maloomat par sawal uthana, mukhtalif perspectives (nuqta-e-nazar) ko dekhna, aur soch samajh kar (informed) faisla karna.
Misal: Agar aap kisi nayi technology ke bare mein parhein, to critical thinking ka matlab hai ke raaye banane se pehle mukhtalif sources aur nuqta-e-nazar dekhein.

blocks.prompt: Critical thinking maloomat ke zimmedarana istemal mein kaise madad deti hai? Asal zindagi ki misalein dein. (Long question 3)
blocks.explanation: Critical thinking hamein kisi baat ko maanne ya share karne se pehle sawal karna sikhati hai: kaun keh raha hai, saboot kya hai, aur doosre sources kya kehte hain. Is se ghalat maloomat aage nahi phailti aur faisle behtar hote hain. Misalein (hamari, kitab ki nahi): 1) Koi viral message kahe ke gharelu nuskha bimari theek karta hai, to forward karne se pehle doctor ya sehat ke official idare se check karein. 2) Nayi technology ya phone khareedne se pehle sirf company ka ishtihar nahi, mukhtalif reviews aur sources dekhein (kitab ki misal bhi yahi kehti hai). 3) Sansani khez headline dekh kar poori khabar parhein aur doosre news organizations se milayein.

items: Critical thinking: sawal karein, mukhtalif nuqta-e-nazar dekhein, soch samajh kar faisla karein.
